choices.why: It is the only brown leather sofa, with the warm aged look the user asked for, and the chaise anchors the open space well.
None has wood with black metal legs, so this large, low round walnut table is the warmest wood option to pair with the brown leather and the exposed beams.
Dark metal frame with glass shelves and a wood-look base gives an industrial feel, and at 100 cm it fits beside the door better than the 151 cm unit.
Black metal swing-arm reading lamp with brass details, fully industrial and ideal beside the sofa.
At 250x250 cm it is big enough to sit under the sofa with chaise and the table, in natural jute with a black grid that echoes the dark metal.
A pair of rust cushions adds an earthy accent on the brown leather and picks up the red edge of the rug.
This is the dark pot the user asked for, and its matte finish goes with the black metal of the lamp and shelving.

answer.why: Brown leather, warm wood and dark metal over a natural jute rug build an industrial living room that works with the exposed beams and the oak floor, with no glossy white.
